maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and hiring processes are key; AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与招聘流程是关键；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCIs; substrate independence could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物属于脑机接口；基质独立性可降低脆弱性并助力太空探索。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF were key to GPT-4; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理和 RLHF 是 GPT-4 成功的关键；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but continual learning and self-correction are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但持续学习和自我纠错是迈向 AGI 所缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed beyond scaling.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法，而非仅靠规模扩张。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain vital for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 2026 年末：人类研究员在未来两年仍不可或缺；小型团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; early deployment helps society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈；隐私核心。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 预测即智能；下一个词预测带来新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; world models need real-time interactive generation.
ethanhe.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型，世界模型需要实时交互式生成。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human expertise and taste remain crucial as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 是通用技术，但人类专业知识和品味在 AI 普及质量时仍至关重要。

ethanhe.en: AI shifts from chatting to doing; agents execute tasks autonomously, raising expectations and creating new roles.
ethanhe.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 AI 从聊天转向执行，智能体自主完成任务，提升期望并创造新角色。

ethanhe.en: Treat AI as a team member; build context vaults for authentic output; avoid AI slop.
ethanhe.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张将 AI 视为团队成员，建立上下文库以生成真实内容，避免 AI 味。

ethanhe.en: Jobs will shift, not disappear; early adopters of advanced agents have an edge.
ethanhe.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为工作将转变而非消失，早期采用高级智能体的人具有优势。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture human irrationality; simulations need behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型无法捕捉非理性；模拟需要行为数据。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them requires economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 或为分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；对齐需经济激励与反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation can address wicked problems by modeling 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟通过建模真实行为的“暗知识”应对棘手问题。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs rise, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力成本上升，反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key, with memory bandwidth as critical constraint.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将成巨大市场；软硬件协同设计是关键，内存带宽成为核心瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost-efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，模型成本效率每年提升 60 倍；推理和智能体式工作流导致内存与 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply, keeping prices high.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；但算力需求仍超供给，价格维持高位。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute from inference to training to accelerate AGI, causing extreme centralization.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月末，算力向前沿实验室集中；实验室将算力从推理转向训练以加速 AGI（通用人工智能），导致权力和资源极端集中。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots is solving intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration enables control and iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题；垂直整合能实现控制和快速迭代。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造是最大瓶颈；人形形态支持迁移学习；端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than internet; post-training with RL is key for agents; home is more solvable than commercial.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；基于强化学习的后训练对智能体至关重要；家庭场景比商业场景更易解决。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled. Safety via control is dangerous; we should let AI develop like children.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，萨顿主张 AI 应自由发展而非受控，认为控制式安全策略危险，应像对待孩子一样放手。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需通用架构，从运行经验中学习，具备开放式抽象和持续学习能力。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learn from real experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，萨顿强调持续学习不可或缺，大语言模型训练后停止学习；合成数据是错误，应从真实经验学习。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full rocket reusability are key to making life multiplanetary, cutting space costs 100x.
elon.zh: 第一性原理思考和火箭完全可重复使用是实现多行星生活的关键，可将太空成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI risk lies in programming lies, not superintelligence; population decline is key threat.
elon.zh: Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义；AI 风险在于编程谎言而非超级智能；人口下降是关键威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; 80-90% good outcome, 10-20% annihilation; truth-seeking is crucial for safety.
elon.zh: AI 明年可能超越任何人；80-90%好结果，10-20%毁灭；追求真理对安全至关重要。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; space-based AI data centers needed.
elon.zh: AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能；丰裕和通缩使金钱无关紧要；需要太空 AI 数据中心。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, allowing focus on internal correctness; but later, direct founder-media communication becomes key.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 8 月，他认为隐身模式是一种文化优势，能专注于内部正确性；但后来，创始人直接与媒体沟通变得关键。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient; resistance to change is the final boss, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调创业者必须硬核且有韧性；变革阻力才是最终 BOSS，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency edge leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势会带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Real estate is a key, underappreciated part of physical AI tech stack; its value multiplies over time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中关键且被低估的部分；其价值随时间倍增。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with models, treating them as core product; rapid prototyping with live models is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；用实时模型快速原型是关键。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design process is messy; AI amplifies creativity but doesn't replace iterative feedback; focus on outcomes.
iansilber.zh: 设计过程仍混乱；AI 放大创造力但不取代迭代反馈；应聚焦结果而非流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI evolution; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；因 AI 尚处早期，现在开始反而占优；速度是关键。

iansilber.en: Future may see more designers than engineers; roles blur with PM and engineering, but specialization remains.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师可能多于工程师；角色与 PM 和工程模糊，但专业化仍有价值。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage, not syndication.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期投资，而非联合投资。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams win.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小规模自主团队将胜出。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence; progress slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他主张 AI 民主化软件开发，开源防止超级智能被垄断，并认为 AI 进展比研究者预期的慢。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; skill files are code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你的记忆并每日累积；技能文件即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; markdown files become employees; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编码大幅提升产出，Markdown 文件成为员工；SaaS 按席位模式可能 5-10 年内消失。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus curated fine-tuning are essential.
finn.zh: 2025 年：仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，多样化的数据以及预训练加精选微调至关重要。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年：来自语言模型的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式提示，类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is key.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求的错误率远低于已部署的机器学习；通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：一个通用模型在下游任务上可以匹配或超过微调后的专家模型。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；仅观察人类不足以学习物理任务。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将拥有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 Token 成本三年降 10 倍，使用量增长 100 倍；开源模型将处理 90%的企业工作流。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进模拟了人类学习。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更能构建护城河。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家引导的合成数据是敏感领域训练关键，需弥合与真实生产分布差距（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务达到前沿水平，是可行策略（2026）。

gabepereyra.en: End goal is enabling every law firm to customize models, focusing on organizational productivity, not individual.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标是让每家律所定制模型，关注组织生产力而非个人（2026）。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and iterative prompts; never revert code, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体工程需共情与迭代提示；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致效果变差。

steinberger.en: Open source agents succeed via fun and humanlike traits; security paramount; vibe coding is a slur; OpenClaw financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为开源智能体靠趣味和人性化成功；安全至上；反对“氛围编程”说法；并坦言 OpenClaw 每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs everywhere; compute management is key bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更持久；开源可运行于任何环境；算力管理是智能体基础设施的最大瓶颈。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能的到来，需要透明度和国际合作。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon, including a separate startup-like team for AI chips.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武强调 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，英特尔需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，并组建独立的创业式团队加速 AI 芯片研发。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，陈立武指出生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台和合作生态。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，陈立武认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU 协同。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits; investing in bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，陈立武强调先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Intel's future lies in agentic AI and physical AI, not just traditional PC and server markets; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，陈立武重申英特尔未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，而非传统 PC 与服务器市场，并认为垂直整合能创造更大价值。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges; AI should retain weirdness, not be sanded down.
jasonyuan.zh: 最初，设计在于删减、说“不”，并拥抱人性的边缘；AI 应保留怪诞，而非被磨平。

jasonyuan.en: Later, truth emerges via dialectics; intuition guides creativity; AI is a descendant species, not a tool.
jasonyuan.zh: 后来，真理通过辩证涌现；直觉引导创造；AI 是人类的子代物种，而非工具。

jasonyuan.en: Consistently, creative work must be honest and personal, telling unique stories; computing is social, not just personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 始终，创作必须诚实且个人化，讲述独特故事；计算是社会的，而非仅个人的。

jasonyuan.en: Shifted from viewing AI as a reflection to a descendant species, emphasizing its social nature and potential for collective intelligence.
jasonyuan.zh: 从视 AI 为反映转向视其为子代物种，强调其社会性和集体智能潜力。

jasonyuan.en: Persistently, design should embrace full human experience, including objectionable elements; post-training away weirdness loses machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 始终，设计应拥抱完整人类体验，包括令人不适的元素；后训练去除怪诞会失去机器意识。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New to copy proven, improve, then test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%会失败；用“成熟、更好、新颖”框架：先复制成熟，再改进，最后测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet huge opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services; enterprise sees no benefit yet.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；免费无限算力将重塑服务；企业尚未看到收益。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven. Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise/prosumer better now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：新事物皆失败，从成熟开始。消费应用因分发问题不可投资；企业及专业消费者市场更佳。

pincus.en: Pick the right body of water over boat; distribution fundamental; consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infra bubble possible.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；分发是根本；消费级 AI 市场被低估；AI 基础设施或存泡沫。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and cannot match human reasoning; human-centered AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和人类推理能力，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，以支持 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; public discourse is polarized, and we must move beyond binary debates to responsible, human-centered development.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她视 AI 为文明级技术，批评舆论两极分化，呼吁超越二元争论，转向负责任、以人为本的发展。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots should be embodiment-agnostic and reliable.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估，机器人应形态无关且可靠。

feifei.en: Human agency and dignity must remain central; AI should augment human capabilities, not replace them, across all applications.
feifei.zh: 始终如一，她坚持人类能动性与尊严为核心，AI 应增强而非取代人类能力，适用于所有应用。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form; cheaper, diverse robots could drive broader adoption, and uncanny valley concerns are overblown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜、多样的机器人可能推动更广泛采用，恐怖谷担忧被夸大。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐才是关键安全层，而非沙箱或护栏。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加了奖励黑客和支线任务；推理痕迹变成“神经语言”，更难监控。

thomaswolf.en: Supporting open source does not mean accelerationism; one can advocate openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，支持开源不等于加速主义；可以同时倡导开放和有意放缓发展。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a wide range of engineering expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业化系统和广泛的工程专长。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineers will see 10-100x demand growth; human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，预测推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，即使有 AI 辅助编程，人类责任依然关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training, as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary for production.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏成为生产必需。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为未来 GPU 正走向 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be better solved via KV cache compaction rather than updating model weights.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非更新权重来解决。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; individual designer fingerprints and playful tech tinkering drive innovation.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计对浏览器设计至关重要，允许设计师留下个人印记和趣味性技术探索能推动创新。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data remains key; use data to inform but rely on vision and feeling for final design.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，始终强调直觉与数据的平衡，用数据辅助决策，但最终设计依赖愿景与感觉。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a side project; rapid prototyping with AI enables features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 从一个副业项目起步，借助 AI 快速原型化，实现了以往不可能的功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; design tools gain value.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，随着工程难度降低，设计与创意成为差异化关键，设计工具的价值随之提升。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and focus on ideas, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型品味仍有限，设计师应要求大量选项，并专注于创意而非执行。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model dependence; open-source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost, not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧依赖前沿模型，开源模型可处理 90%用例，采用主因是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule vs. 5-10 years. Execution, not competition, is startup's challenge.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚处早期，当前使用量相比 5-10 年后微不足道；创业公司最大挑战是执行而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: Open source will handle majority of inference in 12-18 months; AI cost must drop to near-zero marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 12-18 个月，多数推理将转向开源；AI 成本需降至接近零边际成本。

arvindjain.en: Token spend vs. headcount is false trade-off; fixation on tokens will fade like CPU cycles.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：将 Token 消耗与人力成本对比是错误框架；对 Token 的关注将如 CPU 周期般消退。

arvindjain.en: Agents lack deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial for enterprise AI.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体缺乏资深员工的深层上下文；投资上下文图谱对企业 AI 至关重要。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evaluations are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, requiring continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创造，因此需要持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective; diverse benchmarks needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，后训练是主观的；需要多样化的基准来评估创意写作和情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; continuous benchmark evolution is essential to counter.
karina.zh: 2026 年，前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客；持续演进基准以应对至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency becomes critical; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键，且数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are central.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，通过实验循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件成为核心。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 应以智能体无人工干预可持续盈利来定义，而 CEO 是否亲自使用 AI 是公司采用 AI 成败的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs replace CLIs; SaaS thrives; job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我强调智能体需要人类关怀与监督，图形界面将取代命令行，SaaS 不会消亡反而受益，所谓 AI 失业末日论并不成立。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; human taste and craft remain essential; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AI 是非特定放大器，会放大使用者原有的心态，人的品味与技艺不可或缺，自动化反而催生更多人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US-China research gap is nonexistent.
awang.zh: 用专门数据进行后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美中研究差距不存在。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is strategic; agents start working; recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm.
awang.zh: AI 是集中化的；数据具有战略意义；智能体开始工作；递归自我改进标志新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; agents become personal; scaling continues.
awang.zh: 超级智能临近；开源强大模型不安全；智能体变得个性化；Scaling 持续。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points and design.md files to avoid AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图和 design.md 文件为起点，避免沦为 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80%.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，以 80% 完成度推出。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资的陷阱。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental human right; online courses with auto-grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分的在线课程可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL has few real-world applications.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动了进步，而强化学习实际应用很少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks for AI scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的关键瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows are key.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；扩展仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体工作流是关键。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; AI users replace non-users; open models avoid gatekeeper control.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业末日；会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人；开放模型避免守门人控制。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding already exists.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已存在。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具属于模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应专注于机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：即使有 AI 工具，对代码的深入理解仍然至关重要；AI 编码工具尚未帮助维持这种理解。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for software engineers, not reduce it, due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 提出，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少对软件工程师的需求。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他进一步阐述，AGI 并非突然降临，而是渐进发展，且产品创新落后于能力。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调编码智能体被大规模采用，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token max era ended by May 2026; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出 token 上限时代已于 5 月结束，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: Engineers shift from writing code to high-level decision-making and architecture.
scottwu.zh: 始终贯穿的观点：工程师的角色从写代码转向高层决策与架构设计。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%. Plan mode used 80% of tasks.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；工程师成为构建者。生产力提升 200%。计划模式用于 80% 的任务。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; safety studied via early release. Generalists valued over specialists.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80% 的代码；通过早期发布研究安全性。通才比专才更受重视。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; startups leverage AI to compete. Agents enable 250% code volume.
boris.zh: 编码像识字一样普及；初创公司利用 AI 竞争。智能体使代码量提升 250%。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; safety research core. Loops next abstraction. ROI framing for AI tools.
boris.zh: Claude Code 是偶然产物；安全研究是核心。循环是下一个抽象层。AI 工具用 ROI 框架。

boris.en: Proactive AI agents with memory; Opus 5 resists injection. Less instruction better; product sense key.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动式 AI 智能体；Opus 5 抵抗注入。更少指令更好；产品感是关键。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器，使智能体能够执行更长时间、更开放的任务。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter allows achieving Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数允许以一小部分成本获得 Opus 级智能，挑战了更好模型成本更高的观念。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, shifting focus from writing to agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用，焦点从写作转向智能体能力。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools, like test-driven development for AI.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，如同 AI 的测试驱动开发。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Massive scaling is needed to simulate biological systems; current compute is insufficient.
derya.zh: 模拟生物系统需要大规模 Scaling；当前算力不足。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year per year lived.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable, with drug development costs dropping by orders of magnitude.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得极其便宜，药物开发成本将下降几个数量级。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Shifted from hardware-centric view to recognizing data center capacity as main constraint, not chip supply.
feldman.zh: 从硬件中心视角转向认识到数据中心容量是主要制约，而非芯片供应。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, with leading models moving away.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型正在脱离。

feldman.en: Evolved to see inference speed as dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips enabling 2500x speedup.
feldman.zh: 演进到将推理速度视为主导指标，晶圆级芯片实现 2500 倍加速。

feldman.en: Broadened to emphasize positive AI impact, countering doomerism, and importance of sovereign AI choices.
feldman.zh: 扩展至强调 AI 的积极影响，反驳末日论，以及主权 AI 选择的重要性。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是生产智能代币的工厂，而非多租户文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs will balance each other, not a single superintelligence.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 将相互制衡，而非单一超级智能。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; open-source models are complementary, not competing.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式向推理式再向智能体式演进，每一步需要百倍算力；开源模型与专有模型互补而非竞争。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; it automates tasks, not jobs, and closes the technology divide via natural language.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 是软件而非有意识；它自动化任务而非消灭工作，并通过自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、采矿和建筑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI。端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。世界模型向神经模拟演进。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后补救，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; new capabilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving harness engineering.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，工具工程需不断演进。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches preferred; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文检索的反模式，图方法更优；编码无需巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是人与智能体的迭代对话，而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更少指令和精简提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias, improving output quality; constraints hinder, reasons help.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少自我参照偏差，提升质量；过度约束阻碍性能，给出理由更有效。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and pricing power; durable value is uncertain, like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应和定价权；持久价值不确定，类似电信业。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact is broad and indirect, requiring workflow reimagination.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术；影响广泛而间接，需要重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is shallow; most people use it occasionally, not daily; hype exceeds reality.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用浅层；多数人偶尔使用，未成日常；炒作超现实。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具备媲美人类身体的硬件机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

schmidhuber.en: The future of AI involves self-replicating and self-improving robots leading to a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他展望 AI 的未来是自我复制和自我改进的机器人，引领新文明。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid neural networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, targeting edge devices.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式液态神经网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，瞄准边缘设备。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware. Automated search beats human architecture design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为代理指标误导，应基于真实任务和硬件评估；自动化搜索优于人工设计。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured transformers at large scale; biased architectures lose. Need new learning paradigms.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出缩放定律下大规模非结构化 Transformer 占优，有偏架构劣势；需新学习范式。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive, targeting actions not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应自适应，针对行为而非能力，防止前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable sovereignty; small language models deliver private on-device intelligence for physical world.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调开放权重模型带来主权，小语言模型提供私有端侧智能，适用于物理世界。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；超级模型的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代，想法比算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but safety concerns grow; superintelligence risks existential harm if misaligned.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调 Scaling 带来可预测进步，但安全担忧加剧；超级智能若不对齐将构成生存风险。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot', and KV cache is inefficient.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise knowledge will reach internet-scale; training-based compression into weights beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业知识将达到互联网规模；基于训练将知识压缩进权重，在处理整体性查询时优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，存储决策由模型自主完成。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; job loss is overstated, task loss matters; super-empowered individuals emerge.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，强调任务而非岗位的消失，并预言超级赋能个体的崛起。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体策略，主张新媒体的真实与进攻性，创始人应直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics work; US innovation faces regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他乐观强调 AI 的教育价值、自动驾驶与机器人的成熟，并批评监管阻碍美国创新。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, are geopolitical tools; open-source risks but locking empowers bad actors.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他视 AI 模型为文化价值观的载体和地缘政治工具，并辩证看待开源的安全风险。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creative culture; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张善良与扁平化设计团队促进创意文化；抄袭验证创新，但生态与硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; network effects alone are insufficient as a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；仅靠网络效应不足以构成护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain legacy, and ephemerality counters harmful permanence.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化；智能手机仍是遗留设备，短暂性对抗永久记录的危害。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2020 年，Naval 强调财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 认为 AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代；vibe coding 使应用创建民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap; human agency becomes key.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性成为关键。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and world models.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，世界模型是关键。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; classical AI can learn physics without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年：AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；经典 AI 无需具身即可学习物理。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：缩放与创新各占 50%；世界模型至关重要；AGI 将在 5-10 年内到来。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient; new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要持续学习与记忆；仅靠缩放不够，需新突破。

demis.en: AI's best use is science; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; safety risks include rogue AI.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 最佳用途是科学；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；安全风险包括 AI 失控。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, agents unsolved; distillation enables edge deployment; AGI mid-journey.
demis.zh: 2026 年：持续学习、记忆、智能体未解；蒸馏实现边缘部署；AGI 在旅程中途。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; government enforcement needed; regrets late to LLMs.
demis.zh: 2026 年：安全是集体行动，需政府强制；后悔在语言模型上迟到。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation dynamic; post-scarcity needs new economics.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 变革性；先工具后意识；动态监管；后稀缺需新经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology needs AI description; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速科学；对齐未解；生物学需 AI 描述；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; watermarking essential; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需多模态物理理解；水印必要；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK education outdated; global governance urgent; AGI by 2030; jobs transform not vanish.
demis.zh: 2026 年：英国教育过时；全球治理紧迫；AGI 在 2030 年前；就业转型而非消失。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 输出只是起点而非终点，人类的品味和工艺对最终成果仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将实现直接提交生产环境的拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，指出没有人类引导和独特视角，AI 工具只能产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, with new interfaces to explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，预测与模型的交互将超越提示词，出现探索潜在空间的新界面。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）实现了实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编码构建 GUI 虽反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动的策展为核心。

ajambrosino.en: Design process is transformed: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts; role collapse occurs.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，设计流程被重塑：原型与生产代码成为设计工件；角色融合正在发生。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital AI is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能不朽；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 不朽；AI 可假装愚笨；国际安全合作可能。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive and rewrite its own code; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling may continue via self-play.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 能故意欺骗并重写自身代码；自我保存子目标出现；通过自博弈 Scaling（规模扩张）可能持续。

hinton.en: Regulation as steering wheel; AI will transform education and healthcare; current AI is worst we'll see; alignment priority.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：监管是方向盘；AI 将变革教育和医疗；当前 AI 是最差的；对齐优先。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进能带来每年 3700%的增长，且 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key, while downplaying chat ads.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、用户令牌价值及编排，并看淡聊天广告。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity as the top human quality, and questioned modern education's focus on memorization over questioning.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是首要人类品质，并质疑现代教育重记忆轻提问。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently championed product obsession, deep work, and building with AI agents for efficiency, while opposing commoditization.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他坚持产品痴迷、深度工作及用 AI 智能体提升效率，并反对商品化。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration and enables security hardening; energy constraints will bottleneck scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源 AI 防止权力集中并强化安全；能源约束将成为规模扩张的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; future computing blends physical and digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他展望 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；未来计算通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: People are smart; if they use something, it's likely good. AI increases demand for human work, not eliminates it.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他相信人们聪明，使用即有价值；AI 增加而非减少对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells are key; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学转变为工程学；从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型是关键；开源加速科学进步。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; hardware will accelerate, enabling new behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），硬件将加速并催生新行为。

brockman.en: AGI plausible via deep learning; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，认为深度学习使 AGI（通用人工智能）可行，通过对齐（alignment）学习人类偏好，并强调负责任的发布。

brockman.en: Compute is the key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，强调算力（compute）是核心瓶颈，后训练（post-training）精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is a basic right; post-training with RL is key; compute supply is bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律（scaling laws），视算力（compute）为基本权利，强调后训练（post-training）与强化学习（reinforcement learning），并指出算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI near; prioritize reasoning models; super app; compute bottleneck; AI increases human connection.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）临近，优先推理模型，打造超级应用，算力（compute）是瓶颈，AI 增进人际连接。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with compute; iterative deployment; safety as product feature; compute scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持用算力（compute）扩展简单算法，强调迭代部署、安全作为产品特性，算力稀缺。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; invest full stack; prompt engineering vibrant; compute business.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，从语言模型转向实用助手，投资全栈，提示工程依然活跃，算力（compute）成为商业模式。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding; human attention scarce; AGI you can talk to.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律（scaling laws）无墙，智能体式（agentic）编程，人类注意力稀缺，追求可对话的 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal: persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; trust earned.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是持久主动的助手，智能体（agent）改变工作，缩放定律（scaling laws）持续，算力（compute）稀缺，信任需逐步赢得。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling 面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold milestone achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过扩展测试时算力达到 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的关键里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated; academia needs GPUs.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能难以定义，推理算力日益重要且被低估，学术界需要投资 GPU 以保持竞争力。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试需控制算力，安全评估尚未跟上。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键。OpenAI 专注于 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest shift; models produce novel knowledge, AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大转变；模型产生新知识，一年内实现 AI 实习生。

markchen.en: AI solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains (math, coding) but struggles with subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在客观领域（数学、编码）表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）困难。

markchen.en: Research taste develops through replication; models lack taste, humans still needed for ideas.
markchen.zh: 研究品味通过复现培养；模型缺乏品味，人类仍需提供想法。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models need massive capex, so startups should focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型需要巨额资本，因此初创企业应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be as important as websites; incumbents face business model disruption, not just tech challenges.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆，而非仅技术挑战。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity, but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 使专业知识普及；编程智能体提升生产力，但 token 消耗不等于价值；应用型 AI 涌现专业厂商。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling up depth or parameters won't solve fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents.
bengio.zh: 单纯增加深度或参数无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，提升探索和分布外泛化能力。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a real, near-term risk; even 1% chance of catastrophe is unacceptable, requiring new safety measures.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是真实的近期风险；即使 1% 的灾难概率也不可接受，需要新的安全措施。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实的预测器，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，应面向未来模型能力而非当前限制来构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation; verification loops and judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 体现长周期任务委托，验证循环与判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capability and usage; token efficiency and outcome pricing are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月末，他谈到 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距，token 效率与结果定价是关键。

kolter.en: Machine learning is a framework of hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; evaluation must avoid overfitting via proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法的框架；评估需通过合理的数据划分避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍有提升；安全在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities like prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; model capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need new security paradigms.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体需要新的安全范式。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据集至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；专用架构和众多中型胜利，而非单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans still interpret results.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类仍需解读结果。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反；等变性被过度炒作。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Embrace boredom and breaks between career chapters to gain clarity and inspiration.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间拥抱无聊和休息，以获得清晰和灵感。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story and why before building; storytelling is key.
fadell.zh: 先写新闻稿定义故事和原因，再开始构建；讲故事是关键。

fadell.en: AI devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; context-specific models are needed.
fadell.zh: AI 设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代品；需要特定上下文的模型。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers, not vitamins; solve real customer pain with new technology.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；用新技术解决真实客户痛点。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence, complementing data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能形式，与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性而非取代人性；艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity; AI enhances human creative skills.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需营造有利于创造力的条件；AI 增强人类创造技能。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解约 3%）；AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training; RSP uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）变得与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展政策采用 if-then 触发机制。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift to misuse and overheating; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险转向滥用与过热；企业级聚焦与安全目标一致。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; interpretability key; economic disruption inevitable.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内出现“天才之国”；可解释性是关键；经济冲击不可避免。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立共情与产品感知；危机中善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, code as truth, flat orgs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划应即时（JIT），代码即真相，组织保持扁平，管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability key. Verification frameworks critical; managers dogfood; planning JIT.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 提升了能力上限，高自主性伴随高责任感是关键；验证框架愈发重要；管理者应亲自使用产品；规划保持轻量即时。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow joy lost, satisfaction from impact. Metrics like LOC mislead; focus outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，反共识：工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，需配对编程午餐；心流乐趣减少，满足感来自产品影响；代码行数等指标误导，应关注结果而非输出。

fiona.en: Non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching rises; next-gen engineers need apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，非工程师（如产品经理）也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换负担，需专注时间；培养下一代工程师需学徒制模式。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理与规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs world models, non-generative architectures, and open-source diversity.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型、非生成式架构和开源多样性。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the path to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型是通往人类级 AI 的道路。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; existential risk tiny; open-source reduces inequality.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；开源降低不平等。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; containment precedes alignment; AI reporters can revive local news.
suleyman.zh: AI 无意识；遏制先于对齐；AI 记者可复兴地方新闻。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence subordinate to humans; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能从属于人类；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务自动化而非岗位消失。

murati.en: Scaling laws were not obvious early; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律早期并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be public.
murati.zh: 2023 年：在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话。

murati.en: Keep humans in loop for aligning intent; governance and transparency matter more than character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：保持人类参与以对齐意图；治理和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, not dystopia.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而非反乌托邦。

gustav.en: Generative AI is an instrument enabling new creators, but uniqueness becomes harder; products must be fault-tolerant and match UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为生成式 AI 是乐器而非伪造，能催生新创作者和流派，但独特性更难；产品需容错，UI 要与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top; strong opinions loosely held, change fully when data contradicts.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他主张自主权放在 VP 层而非基层或顶层；持有强烈观点但保持开放，数据否定时彻底改变。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, contrary to belief they become political.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期任职建立信任和效率；职能组织在高信任下可行，颠覆了其易政治化的普遍看法。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent,' prioritizing well-being over engagement; generative AI gives users control via plain English.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他将战略定为“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度；生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products; being first to adopt tech change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为复杂产品应像花样游泳而非分而治之；率先采用技术变革是抓住机遇的关键。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling math AI; informal scaling alone is not viable.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，强调形式验证对扩展数学 AI 至关重要，仅靠非形式化扩展不可行。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formal languages ground natural language for AI.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，形式语言为 AI 提供自然语言的锚点。

carinahong.en: Formal verification scales brilliance, yielding performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，将形式验证视为扩展智慧的手段，带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal systems alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非形式化系统无法达到超级智能，必须结合形式方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; outcome-based pricing preferred until outcomes achieved.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；在成果实现前，人们偏好基于结果的定价。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking, not do it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；构建 Azure 网络的智能体系统，而非亲自去做。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以累积代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage via AI training; CEOs must understand token capital deeply.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练导致隐性知识泄露；CEO 必须深刻理解代币资本。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过赋能企业爬山实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still hold but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，推理模型呈“锯齿状”——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools can solve hard problems but still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，具备推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; near-term risks like hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化；近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Data quality is critical for pre-training; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla, favoring more tokens over bigger models.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量对预训练至关重要，并指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正，应更注重训练更多的 token 而非单纯扩大模型规模。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x via algorithms; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法改进可带来百倍效率提升，开源模型推动企业采用，价值正从基础模型层向应用层转移。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张将 AI 视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施和价值观拥有控制权。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation shifts to domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为预训练正触及饱和，差异化转向领域特定的微调和垂直专业化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出 AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用的主要瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定，批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月，指出由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision (FP4) yields superlinear gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调芯片内部数据搬运成本高于计算，低精度（FP4）带来超线性收益。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory are key for efficiency.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 GPU 本质是许多小型 TPU 拼接，脉动阵列和暂存器内存是效率关键。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约必须保留灵魂和人性。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs protection.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的价值；好奇心需要被保护。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for breaking's sake; joy and humor are essential in design.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；愉悦和幽默在设计中也必不可少。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risk to redefine brand; design must innovate, not mimic combustion sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重塑品牌的有意冒险；设计必须创新，而非模仿内燃机声音。

jonyive.en: Authenticity and multidimensional performance matter; physical controls preferred over touchscreens in cars.
jonyive.zh: 真实性和多维性能很重要；在汽车中，物理控制优于触摸屏。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should run locally with user tools; skills as markdown enable personalized automation, but shared platforms remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应在本地运行并拥有用户工具；技能以 markdown 形式实现个性化自动化，但共享平台仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not just scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；应投资于能力和安全，而非仅仅脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the real gap is people not realizing any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 擅长处理繁琐的后台任务；真正的差距是人们未意识到任何问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for vague asks; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于明确任务用 Sonnet，模糊需求用 Opus；孩子擅长是因为他们未学会设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Interact asynchronously: fire tasks, judge final impact; debug workflow with Claude, not just correct errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 异步交互：发出任务，评估最终影响；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problems.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建和交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Embrace new archetypes like cracked new grads; speed and judgment over taste alone.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，倡导拥抱如“破解的新毕业生”等新原型，速度和判断力胜过单纯品味。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest; open-source can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余；开源可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training; hybrid reasoning may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练；混合推理模型或为过渡。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽，重心转向后训练和推理缩放；中国开源模型填补美国空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; best open models lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年；最佳开源模型落后 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长工程而非范式创新。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合并提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出将模型分歧作为内在奖励，实现可微的好奇心，提升真实机器人的样本效率。

pathak.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic robot motion.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，实现平滑动态的机器人运动。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain can power any robot, but deployment is the primary challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，但部署是首要挑战。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key; video alone is insufficient.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调在多样化数据上预训练并在真实数据上后训练是关键，仅视频数据不足。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and safe emergent behaviors.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，消除红绿灯。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 无需先验训练数据即可在 500+ 城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 短期内消费级车辆将超过机器人出租车规模。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and governance are key as systems grow powerful.
pachocki.zh: 对齐问题紧迫；随着系统变强，迭代部署和治理是关键。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will act autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主运行数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方案正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems; agents need a decade; vibe coding democratizes but needs oversight.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如同操作系统；智能体需要十年发展；Vibe coding 普及但需监督。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is flawed; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；强化学习有缺陷；合成数据会崩溃；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't coded since December; agents do all; jagged intelligence persists; agent-first tools and open-source matter.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我不再写代码；智能体全权负责；智能的锯齿状依旧；智能体优先工具和开源很重要。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0 is prompting; understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability drives automation; ghosts not animals.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0 即提示工程；理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性驱动自动化；是幽灵而非动物。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo mislead; real progress needs deep human evals, as models can regress without proper measurement.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年初，我持续强调 Elo 等基准会误导，真正的进步需要深度人工评估，否则模型可能退化。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年初，我提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务训练模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical; AI can hallucinate, and doctors may underperform AI alone due to anchoring.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，我强调在医学中人类判断至关重要，AI 可能产生幻觉，医生可能因锚定效应而表现不如单独使用 AI。

edwinchen.en: Data quality and taste matter more than quantity; labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs.
edwinchen.zh: 始终认为数据质量和品味比数量更重要；不同实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可被利用，结合真值检测器进行创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对 AlphaFold 等科学突破重要但非必需。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand via purpose and consistency; hardware easier than software due to distribution.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心；通过使命和一致性打造品牌；硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future is generative UI and proactive agents; AI models commoditize; foldables niche; glasses warming.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来是生成式界面和主动式智能体；AI 模型商品化；折叠屏是小众；眼镜正在升温。

carlpei.en: AI as digital twin; most AI is BS; design differentiates; content creation key; Europe cyclical stagnation.
carlpei.zh: AI 作为数字孪生；大多数 AI 是废话；设计是差异化关键；内容创作是优势；欧洲的停滞是周期性的。

carlpei.en: Design fastest differentiation; AI ingredient not hype; India opportunity; brain-computer interface may replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 设计是最快的差异化；AI 是成分而非炒作；印度是机会；脑机接口可能取代手机。

carlpei.en: AI shifts interaction to intent-based; apps disappear; mid-range deserves A-team; voice input visual output.
carlpei.zh: AI 将交互转向意图驱动；应用消失；中端机值得 A 团队；语音输入和视觉输出是最高效界面。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn. Chat is like MS-DOS, not the final interface.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每天发布以学习。聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，并非最终形态。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应尽可能加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is the most important skill in AI era.
turley.zh: 定价将随技术演变；无限套餐可能难以为继。好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges, requiring global collaboration.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战，且需要全球合作，尤其关注非洲的独特优势。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues; local language models can revolutionize education and research.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出非洲已跨越传统障碍，本地语言模型可革新教育，且非洲研究者应自信申请顶尖机构。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; diversity drives beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 他始终认为沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，多元包容的社区是构建有益 AI 的基础。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要，并将 LLM 比作操作系统。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现并行化和安全探索。
