jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据瓶颈，合成数据（来自模拟和世界模型）是未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）是具身 AI 的重大挑战。

jimfan.en: Robot foundation models via simple end-to-end models leveraging diverse data sources.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，主张通过简单端到端模型利用多样数据源构建机器人基础模型。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads AI progress and accelerates research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；编程是 AI 进步的领先指标，并加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievable tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性大幅扩展可完成任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck, not intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，而非智能。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌战略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规范。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，指出品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌，而非公司。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; alternative solutions using less compute likely exist.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；存在使用更少算力的替代方案。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我持续强调预训练赋予模型广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、愉悦的回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；所有方法都归结为数据。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我主张在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Small models can outperform larger ones with better data and algorithms; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我坚信小型模型凭借更优数据和算法可超越大型模型；多元对齐尊重多样化价值观。

shazeer.en: Scaling with compute and data makes AI smarter; next-token prediction is AI-complete.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，认为通过算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithms and hardware.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，模型进步来自算法和硬件双轮驱动。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: AGI requires agentic action and reinforcement learning; test-time compute alone won't suffice.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，指出 AGI 需要智能体式行动和强化学习，仅靠推理时算力扩展不够。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow gap with frontier; AI can generate novel ideas, not just interpolate.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为开源模型缩小与前沿模型的差距，AI 能产生新想法而非仅插值。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师并聚焦问题来推动工作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地与其即兴协作，不拘泥于固定结构。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 未来的设计工具应互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并利用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process documentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应优先展示工艺和意图，而非过程文档。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring managers look for high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘经理寻找具有内在驱动力和学习能力的高成长斜率个体。

nadchishtie.en: Side projects can outweigh traditional experience if they demonstrate care and skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 如果副项目展示出用心和技能，其价值可超过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Paid test work provides more signal than any other interview stage.
nadchishtie.zh: 付费测试工作比其他任何面试环节都更能提供有效信号。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律能预测 AI 进展，但测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更优。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 从 2024 年到 2025 年，我认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程将从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都离不开它们。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; talent gap exceeds funding; focus on skills, not capabilities.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应注重技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; use scalable oversight and interpretability; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化；后训练不足以解决对齐；需要外部监督与监管。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals; RL lacks hierarchical credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年：自博弈和模仿学习是强信号；强化学习缺乏层级化信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning boosts sample efficiency; hard-coding priors limits performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：无监督学习提升样本效率；硬编码先验会限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks, hinting at generality.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年：预训练语言模型将推理迁移到非语言任务，暗示通用性。

abbeel.en: Simulation and RL enable real-world robot skills; reliability is key for value.
abbeel.zh: 始终：模拟和强化学习使机器人技能成为可能；可靠性是关键价值。
